data.long_meaning: A diminutive form of Daniel. Daniel means 'God is my judge'. The name Denny carries the meaning “Little Dan” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Denny usually hope their child will grow to embody little dan and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Denny total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
